courses.title: Software Builder — ForgeDesk to Device Lab Deploy
courses.kinesthetic_hook: Merge a real conflict, ship a checkout API, and pin a digest on local Device Lab compose.
courses.lesson_excerpt: The WAIKE Software ForgeDesk is a two-person civic issue tracker for Device Lab checkouts. Ticket 8801 opens when a volunteer edits routes.py on feature/kiosk-hours while the desk lead edited the same function on main. A conflict is not a personality crisis. It is two hashes that claim the same lines. You will read both sides, keep the authz guard that main added, and keep the hours table that the
courses.worked_example: Parents A and B both touch def open_hours. A adds require_role('desk'). B adds HOURS={...}. Survivor must include both tokens.
courses.assignment: Write a conflict report for ticket 8801 naming both parents, survivor tokens, and one wrong resolution the lab must fail.

courses.title: Hardware Engineering + Embedded Prototyping — ForgeSense Node
courses.kinesthetic_hook: Compute a divider, budget real MPNs, run Zephyr on QEMU, then digitally diagnose a sagging 3V3 rail.
courses.lesson_excerpt: WAIKE Device Lab Hardware Studio opens with SPICE-class network analysis before any iron heats. PHYSICAL_PENDING covers soldering and instruments. Digitally you solve a series divider: R1=1k, R2=3k, Vin=12V → I=3mA, Vout=9V. The lab checks your arithmetic, not a screenshot of a GUI.
courses.assignment: Submit SPICE network JSON and show handwritten KCL at the mid node.

courses.title: Process Improvement + Project Management — Device Lab Flow
courses.kinesthetic_hook: Charter a real wait problem, run DMAIC on fixture data, and critique an AI plan without inventing outcomes.
courses.lesson_excerpt: Process Studio: Device Lab noon checkout wait baseline 15 minutes. Charter states problem, goal metric with baseline, in/out scope. fabricated_outcomes must be false — no invented community impact.
courses.worked_example: problem wait>15m; goal baseline 15m→8m; in_scope queue+staffing; out_scope new building; fabricated_outcomes false.
courses.assignment: Write charter JSON and a one-page sponsor brief without invented stats.
